title: Vermisstes Kind dank Zeugenhinweis angetroffen und Ex-Lebensgefährten der Mutter festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: A two-year-old boy reported missing since 29 May 2026 was found on the U3 subway line at Schlesisches Tor after a witness alerted police. A man accompanying the child was arrested and will be brought before a judge.
